test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

We didn't mean to ______ all of you waiting.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1'** i.e. **'Keep'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct option to fill in the blank is: **'keep'**
 
• The phrase** "keep someone waiting**" is a common idiom in English that means to cause someone to wait or to delay someone. 

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is:* "We didn't mean to keep all of you waiting" means that it was not their intention to cause everyone to wait."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Make"** is used in some idiomatic expressions like "make someone do something," but "make someone waiting" is not a standard phrase in English.
 
• **"Creep"** means to move slowly and carefully in order to avoid being heard or noticed, and it doesn't fit in this context.
 
• **"Seep" **means to flow or leak slowly, as in the case of liquid or gas, and it doesn't make sense in this context.
